topic: Google Cloud Associate Data Practitioner certification exam preparation - Google Cloud's newer associate-level data certification covering preparing and ingesting data, analyzing and presenting data, orchestrating data pipelines, and managing data on Google Cloud, centered on BigQuery, Looker, Dataform, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataplex, and BigQuery ML
exam_format: 50-60 multiple choice and multiple select questions, 2 hours, delivered online-proctored or at an onsite test center. Registration is 125 USD plus applicable tax. No prerequisites; Google recommends 6+ months of hands-on experience working with data on Google Cloud. Passing score is not publicly published by Google (widely estimated around 70%). The certification is valid for 3 years.
question_types: multiple choice (single answer, exactly 4 options) and multiple response clearly marked as 'Select TWO/THREE'
audience: Entry-level and early-career data practitioners, data analysts, and aspiring data engineers who ingest, transform, analyze, and manage data on Google Cloud. Candidates should have roughly 6+ months of hands-on Google Cloud data experience and basic SQL. A natural first data certification and an on-ramp that funnels toward the Professional Data Engineer and Professional Machine Learning Engineer courses in this catalog.
author: Aseem Mankotia

domains.name: Prepare and ingest data
domains.notes: Extract, transform, and load data into Google Cloud: batch and streaming ingestion with Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Datastream, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Storage Transfer Service, and loading into Cloud Storage and BigQuery. Data preparation and cleaning (BigQuery SQL transformations, Dataprep/Dataform concepts), handling structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, file formats, and choosing the right ingestion service for a described source, volume, and latency requirement.

domains.name: Analyze and present data
domains.notes: Query and analyze data with BigQuery SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions, partitioning/clustering awareness). Build visualizations and reports with Looker and Looker Studio, dashboards, and shared explores. Derive insights, use BigQuery ML for simple predictions where appropriate, and present results to stakeholders. Choosing the right analysis and visualization approach and understanding cost/performance of queries.

domains.name: Orchestrate data pipelines
domains.notes: Design and automate repeatable data workflows: scheduling and orchestration with Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataform, Workflows, Cloud Scheduler, and scheduled queries. Build and monitor ETL/ELT pipelines, handle dependencies and retries, trigger downstream jobs, and choose the right orchestration tool for a described pipeline complexity and schedule.

domains.name: Manage data
domains.notes: Govern and operate data on Google Cloud: storage selection and lifecycle (Cloud Storage classes, BigQuery storage), access control with IAM, data governance and cataloging with Dataplex, data quality, metadata, and lineage. Security and privacy basics (encryption, CMEK awareness, data masking/column-level security, VPC Service Controls awareness), plus cost management and quotas. Choosing the correct management, governance, or cost control for a described requirement.

extra_guidance: The Google Cloud Associate Data Practitioner is Google's accessible entry-level data certification and a high-volume, low-barrier play - the marketing angle is 'your first Google Cloud data certification', and the funnel points learners toward the Professional Data Engineer and Professional Machine Learning Engineer courses in this catalog. ACCURACY note: the four domain NAMES above are Google's official exam-guide sections (used verbatim); Google does NOT publish official percentage weightings for this exam, so the percentages above are our editorial distribution - present the domain names as official but do NOT claim the percentages are Google's figures. BigQuery is the through-line of the exam, with Looker/Looker Studio for presentation and Cloud Composer/Dataform for orchestration. This is an applied, service-selection exam - practice questions should be scenario-based with 'best/most cost-effective Google Cloud service' framing and plausible distractors, but kept at associate difficulty (less deep architecture than the Professional Data Engineer exam). Cover the classic decision pairs at an associate level: batch vs streaming ingestion (Dataflow vs Pub/Sub vs Data Transfer Service), Cloud Storage classes, BigQuery partitioning vs clustering, Looker vs Looker Studio, Cloud Composer vs scheduled queries vs Workflows, Dataplex for governance. Labs are BigQuery and Looker Studio console read-and-understand walkthroughs (load data, run a query, build a report, schedule a transform), not deep CLI. Final chapter must be a full exam simulation with a 2-hour / 50-60-question time-management strategy. Scan the practice bank for other-vendor terms (AWS/Azure) before upload per the pipeline compliance rules.
